commands.name: receipt-total
commands.description: Total the saved sessions of the last N days (the kept days by default).

commands.name: receipt-month
commands.description: Show a month's tally of sessions, turns, tokens and cost (this month by default).

commands.name: receipt-clear
commands.description: Save this session, then drop the other saved session records. The monthly tallies stay.
commands.output: Dropped 0 session records. This session's record and the monthly tallies are kept.
